title: Winter Peak Adder in Residential Natural Gas Supply Re-Contract Pricing
content:
**Pricing note.** On a Residential Natural Gas Supply re-contract after rollover, the winter peak adder depends on the largest usage in therms billed on any single energy line of the agreement: 0.0100 per therm when that peak is 180 therms or more, 0.0050 per therm when it is 120 therms or more but below 180, and no adder when it is below 120 therms. The adder raises the re-contract rate by that amount per therm.

The peak is the single highest therm figure among all energy charge lines on the agreement's bill ledger; service fee lines and credit lines carry no therms and do not enter it.

| Largest therms on one energy line | Winter peak adder per therm |
|---|---|
| 180 or more | 0.0100 |
| 120 to 179 | 0.0050 |
| below 120 | none |

### Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical ledgers)

| Agreement's largest energy line | Adder |
|---|---|
| 180 therms | 0.0100 |
| 179 therms | 0.0050 |
| 120 therms | 0.0050 |
| 119 therms | none |

A ledger whose January line billed 182 therms and whose other lines billed less carries the 0.0100 adder, whatever the other months billed.
